seed_strategy.rule: Fixed evaluation seeds; development seeds 0-9 disjoint. Paired conditions per seed; trials are not independent seeds.

stopping_rule: Complete every declared seed/condition budget once; 1200s safety timeout per protocol; retain all failures, non-finite states and scientific negatives. No outcome-based retuning or retries.
inclusion_criteria: All declared controls and fixed seeds
Complete raw observations and finite-value validation
exclusion_criteria: No post-hoc statistical exclusions. Invalid/incomplete attempts remain in the campaign inventory.

analysis_plan.inference_policy: Exploratory; no automatic EVID promotion; no external preregistration or independent replication claimed.
planned_tests: For dimensions: output_spikes, 5D minus each of 2D,3D,4D,6D,8D, paired per seed; Holm family of five. Random graph descriptive only.
For association: accuracy learning_on minus each of off, sham, reset, shuffle; Holm family of four.
Each family: exact two-sided seed sign flips, 2000 seed-paired bootstrap resamples using RNG910, percentile 95% CI; degenerate dz is null.
Brian2: absolute v/u errors and exact spike equality, no p-value. Scaling: descriptive per seed/N, no p-value.
limitations: n=10 or3 only; engineered workload; sign-flip symmetry not demonstrated
No universal 5D optimality, AGI, cognition, consciousness, full-framework speed advantage or independent ethical approval

budgets: 128 neurons,1024 edges,outdegree8,weights20, delays1..4 equally;256ticks,8 input/8 output cells,pulses0 and128. Six real D-guided graphs plus six identical-graph labels and one random graph. In-degree/motifs not matched; canonical IDs remain5D.
